Katar Combat Styles

Choose Katar for Guard-based counterattacks and ally protection, or for attacks that hinder a target.

Katar - Iron Guard

Iron Guard includes a counterattack enhanced by a recent Guard and a link that shares some of your Guard with an ally.

Katar - Scrapper

Scrapper attacks can hinder targets with effects such as Hamstring or Dazed.
